Posts.RecruitPostName: 海外休闲IAP（二合）产品负责人
Posts.Responsibility:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1. 产品全局把控： 主导休闲消除类游戏产品的整体方向和愿景，制定清晰的产品路线图和升级战略，确保从0到1的创意落地以及从1到N的持续迭代增长，实现产品代际跃升；
2. 跨部门协同： 密切与用户获取（UA）、市场发行、数据分析和商业化团队合作，根据海外市场的买量策略和增长机制及时调整产品方向；结合市场反馈和数据洞察，制定游戏运营活动、付费策略和功能更新计划，推动产品持续增长与长期留存；
3. 质量与进度负责： 把控游戏开发的关键里程碑和最终质量，对产品的品质、进度和预算负责；及时识别和解决项目风险和瓶颈，确保产品按计划上线并达到预期的用户满意度和商业目标；

岗位要求
1. 行业经验： 8年以上游戏开发从业经验，3年以上制作人/主策/产品负责人角色经验，深耕手机休闲游戏领域；
2. 产品类型成功经历： 拥有二合品类休闲游戏的成功项目经验，曾主导或深度参与过知名相关产品的开发或运营；项目月流水超过500万美金。
3. 发行思维： 深刻理解海外移动游戏市场的用户获取渠道和产品增长机制，熟悉买量投放、市场营销和商业化策略；具备数据驱动的思维方式，善于通过A/B测试和用户数据指导产品迭代，提高关键指标（留存、LTV等）；
4. 跨职能协作： 优秀的沟通协调能力，能够在产品、研发与运营等不同部门之间架起桥梁，并与用户获取、发行、营销、商业化等职能团队紧密协作，确保产品开发与市场策略步调一致；
5. 团队领导力： 出色的领导管理才能和人际沟通技巧，善于发掘和培养人才。曾经成功组建并管理过不少于10人的跨职能游戏开发或运营团队；能够在多元文化环境中工作，激励团队实现高绩效；
加分项：
1. 海外合作经验： 有与国际游戏工作室联合开发项目的经验者优先；了解海外合作方的工作方式，能有效管理时区差异和跨文化沟通；
2. 知名企业背景： 曾在国际或国内一流休闲游戏公司担任核心制作岗位者优先，对精品休闲手游的研发流程和品质要求有一线认知；
3. 全球发行经验： 有面向全球市场发行游戏的经验，熟悉海外各主要地区玩家偏好和市场趋势；曾主导产品获得海外市场成功者尤佳；
4. 激情与创新： 对休闲手游充满热情，关注最新的游戏玩法趋势和创新机制，拥有敏锐的市场洞察力和创造性思维，愿意大胆尝试将产品提升到新的高度。
5. 语言能力： 能够熟练地用英语进行沟通和报告，能够在跨国团队中协同工作，并有效地与海外合作伙伴进行交流更佳。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。
Work Location: China-Beijing | China-Shenzhen

Posts.RecruitPostName: Technical Account Manager Intern 107540
Posts.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Cloud is expanding its global enterprise customer support capabilities and is seeking motivated individuals to join us as Technical Account Management Intern. As a TAM Intern, you will gain hands-on experience supporting enterprise customers throughout their post-sales cloud journey. Working alongside experienced Technical Account Managers, you will assist in monitoring cloud performance, supporting customer issue resolution, and contributing to solution optimization initiatives. This internship provides practical exposure to customer lifecycle management, cloud operations, and cross-functional collaboration. If you are passionate about cloud technologies and aspire to become a trusted technical advisor to enterprise clients, this role offers an excellent foundation.
 
Responsibilities
Assist Technical Account Managers in supporting enterprise customers across their post-sales lifecycle, including onboarding, solution validation, and operational follow-up
Support monitoring of cloud performance metrics and help identify potential optimization opportunities
Participate in customer meetings to document technical requirements, operational challenges, and follow-up actions
Assist in troubleshooting coordination by working with product and engineering teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues
Contribute to preparation of customer reports, technical documentation, and service review materials
Support internal knowledge sharing and best practice documentation to enhance customer success operations

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical disciplines; candidates from other majors with strong technical interest are encouraged to apply
Expected to graduate between Q4 2026 and 2027 and able to maintain valid student status during the internship
Available for a minimum 3-month full-time internship commitment
Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts such as IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, networking, and system architecture
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with good communication capabilities
Passionate about cloud technologies and customer success management
Proficient in both Korean and Chinese Mandarin to communicate with China headquarters stakeholders and support product material coordination

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: S.Korea-Seoul

About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
1. Support public cloud operations and management, including resource planning, cost optimization, account governance, and cloud infrastructure lifecycle management
2. Manage and ensure the reliability of big data platforms (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Flink) in cloud environments
3. Design highly available architectures tailored to business needs and define operational standards and incident playbooks
4. Participate in technology choices, performance tuning, and stability enhancements for core infrastructure

Who We Look For
1. Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or related field (current students or fresh graduates welcome)
2. Basic knowledge of Linux, networking, and containerization (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes); eager to learn and grow
3. Familiarity with at least one public cloud platform (AWS, Tencent Cloud, GCP, or Azure) is a plus
4. Proficient in at least one scripting language (Python, Shell, or SQL)
5. Interest in big data technologies (Hadoop/Spark/Flink) is a plus; hands-on experience not required
6. Experience with AI-assisted programming tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) is preferred
7. Fluent in both Chinese and English, with good communication and teamwork skills

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Singapore-CapitaSky
